title: Fixed Edge Bed and Rear Thread Mast Overlock Machine
description: One newly authored complete fixed tabletop overlock-sewing-machine-style exterior. A compact asymmetric case has a short projecting left head over a small outboard edge bed with a genuine needle-plate slot, a broad lower front enclosure and one full right-side handwheel. Separate blunt needle-bar and presser-foot appearances occupy the open edge-working gap. Four front tension-disc appearances are backed by the head, while an integrated rear platform holds four opaque whole cone exteriors under a tall complete mast and horizontal guide bar with four actual open eyelets. Four finite flat feet support the whole base. No large open C throat, dedicated sewing table, chair or foot treadle is copied from the old lockstitch workstation. All numeric geometry new; one prop zero scenes and three opaque materials. Static game art only: no fabric, cutting blade, continuous threading path, needle movement, actual tension, stitches, motor operation, manufacture, ergonomic or machine-safety claim.
